events.description: A proxy killer plug-in was added that blocks proxies for both registration and login.
A new Graphics Market section was added under Service Offerings for graphics service sales.
Opera Mini has been firewalled because ban evaders and scammers were using it like a VPN.
An impersonator of Omniscient (@jesselabrocca) is posting infected links on Twitter; the only official HF Twitter is @HackForumsNet.
Official mods list page (modlist.php) and staff list page (stafflist.php) were added.
An official Google +1 button was added to the footer to help with SEO.
Interview with Joey Tribbiani conducted by Kyle FYI™; covers his views on the Mentors expansion, the Vouch system, and personal interests.
